name: Netting Eligible 1 Code
definition: Specifies whether the trade is eligible for netting.

GROS.name: Gross
GROS.definition: Indicates that the trade is not eligible for settlement netting.

NETT.name: Nett
NETT.definition: Indicates that the trade is eligible for settlement netting.

AGFS.name: Aggregation For Settlement
AGFS.definition: Grouping of receipts/purchases to create one settlement obligation, and the grouping of deliveries/sales to create one settlement obligation.
